title: A silent mutation
caption: Changing the last base of the Lys codon from AAG to AAA does not change the amino acid, because the code is degenerate: the protein is unchanged.
alt: The start of the beta-globin coding strand and the same sequence with the ninth codon changed from AAG to AAA; the protein is the same.
description: The ninth codon AAG codes for lysine.
AAA also codes for lysine, so the protein is unchanged.
